headline: Fierce Clashes Shake Central Fronts as Key Strongpoints Trade Hands
war_summary: On the 197th day of combat, violent engagements across the central and northern hexes have driven casualty figures sharply upward as key strongpoints repeatedly trade hands. Weathered Expanse stands as the storm center of the war desk, registering fifty-nine territorial shifts over the past twenty-four hours, notably around Wightwalk and Frostmarch, with casualty tallies surpassing seventeen thousand combined. Heavy attrition similarly grips Linn of Mercy and Dead Lands, where intense reciprocal assaults at The First Coin and The Salt March have yielded massive losses on both sides. To the east and west, shifting lines in Stonecradle and Stlican Shelf remain hotly contested, marked by dozens of base flips around Trammel Pool, Breaker Town, and The Pale House. Meanwhile, Godcrofts has seen fluid island maneuvering leaving two strategic bases in ruins amid ongoing skirmishes. Across the broader theater, rear supply corridors remain quiet, but front-line sectors continue to burn under mounting enlistments and unrelenting pressure.
